# Get all liked songs (paginate through all pages)
liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=login_result['access_token'], page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total liked songs: {len(liked_songs)}")
print(liked_songs[:3])
